Başlık (TR): Diesel Partikül Filtresi Lamp Command - Check main fuel tank level first as low fuel can affect HC dosing supply pressure. Inspect the aftertreatment fuel filter and replace if clogged. Check fuel supply lines to the dosing system for leaks or restrictions. If filter and lines are good have the HC dosing pump tested and replaced if not generating adequate pressure. What does Detroit Diesel SPN 3697 FMI 16 mean? It means the fuel pressure supplying the hydrocarbon dosing system is below the required threshold, preventing the system from delivering adequate fuel to the exhaust for active DPF regeneration. What causes SPN 3697 FMI 16? The most common causes are a failing HC dosing pump, a clogged aftertreatment fuel filter, a fuel supply line restriction or leak, low fuel tank level, or a faulty fuel pressure sensor. Can I keep driving with SPN 3697 FMI 16? Short distances may be possible but without adequate HC dosing fuel pressure active regeneration cannot complete and soot will accumulate leading to more severe DPF faults and derate. Will SPN 3697 FMI 16 cause a derate? Not immediately but as soot accumulates from failed regeneration cycles more severe DPF soot codes will trigger derate conditions. How do I clear SPN 3697 FMI 16? Check fuel level and replace the aftertreatment fuel filter. If pressure remains low inspect the HC dosing pump and fuel supply lines. Once adequate fuel pressure is restored and a successful active regeneration completes the code should clear.

What does Detroit Diesel SPN 3698 FMI 16 mean? It means the fuel pressure in the aftertreatment hydrocarbon dosing system has exceeded the maximum acceptable threshold, indicating a problem with pressure regulation in the HC dosing circuit. What causes SPN 3698 FMI 16? The most common causes are a faulty pressure regulator, a blocked HC dosing fuel return line, a failing dosing pump delivering excessive pressure, or a clogged dosing injector creating pressure buildup. If the regen fails to complete again have the HC dosing injector, DPF temperature sensors, and regen control system inspected by a qualified diesel technician. What does Detroit Diesel SPN 3826 FMI 16 mean? It means a DPF regeneration cycle was started but did not complete successfully, allowing soot to remain in the filter above acceptable levels. What causes SPN 3826 FMI 16? The most common causes are the regen inhibit switch being active, the vehicle being moved during a parked regen, insufficient exhaust temperatures, a faulty HC dosing injector, or a heavily loaded DPF requiring multiple regen attempts. Can I keep driving with SPN 3826 FMI 16? Short distances may be possible but repeated incomplete regens will cause soot to build to critical levels. A successful parked regeneration should be completed as soon as safely possible. Will SPN 3826 FMI 16 cause a derate? It can if incomplete regens allow soot to accumulate to critical levels triggering a more severe DPF soot fault and derate condition. How do I clear SPN 3826 FMI 16? Complete a successful parked regeneration with the inhibit switch off and the vehicle stationary throughout the full cycle. If regen continues to fail have the HC dosing injector and regen control system inspected. The code should clear once a full successful regen is completed.

Başlık (TR): Egzoz Ard İşlem 1 Dizel Egzoz Sıvısı Dozaj Isıtma Modu Talebi - Start by checking DEF tank level and refilling if low. Inspect the DEF filter and replace if clogged. Check DEF supply lines for restrictions or air ingestion points. If level and filter are good have the DEF pump output and dosing injector tested as wear or partial blockage in either component is a common cause of this fault. What does Detroit Diesel SPN 4353 FMI 18 mean? It means the DEF system is injecting less fluid into the exhaust than the ECM requires to properly reduce NOx emissions through the SCR catalyst. What causes SPN 4353 FMI 18? The most common causes are a worn DEF pump, a partially clogged dosing injector, low DEF level, a clogged DEF filter, or restricted supply lines. Can I keep driving with SPN 4353 FMI 18? Short distances may be possible but insufficient DEF injection will cause SCR efficiency to drop and a derate condition will follow if not addressed. Will SPN 4353 FMI 18 cause a derate? Yes. When DEF injection quantity falls below required levels the SCR system cannot meet emissions thresholds and the ECM will trigger a derate condition. How do I clear SPN 4353 FMI 18? Check DEF level and filter first then inspect the dosing injector and pump for wear or blockage. Once the system confirms DEF is being delivered at the correct quantity the code should clear.

Başlık (TR): Egzoz Ard İşlem 1 Dizel Egzoz Sıvısı Pompası Tahrik Yüzdesi - Inspect the DEF doser valve for signs of crystallization or physical damage. Check the valve wiring and connector for corrosion or damage. If the valve is crystallized it may be cleanable but replacement is often the more reliable fix. Have the valve solenoid tested for proper electrical response before condemning the part. What does Detroit Diesel SPN 4375 FMI 18 mean? It means the DEF doser valve is not responding correctly to ECM commands, preventing accurate control of DEF delivery to the SCR catalyst. What causes SPN 4375 FMI 18? The most common causes are a stuck or crystallized doser valve, an electrical fault at the valve solenoid, or damaged wiring in the doser valve circuit. Can I keep driving with SPN 4375 FMI 18? Short distances may be possible but without proper doser valve function the SCR system cannot operate correctly and a derate condition is likely to follow. Will SPN 4375 FMI 18 cause a derate? Yes. If the ECM cannot control DEF dosing through the valve the SCR system will fail to meet emissions thresholds and a derate will be triggered. How do I clear SPN 4375 FMI 18? Inspect, clean, or replace the DEF doser valve and verify wiring integrity. Once the valve responds correctly to ECM commands and the SCR system confirms proper DEF delivery the code should clear.
